ios.desc:
Take control of your finances with CoinCount, the fast and easy way:

• 1) Record your income and expenses in just two taps for lightning-fast tracking.
• 2) Get a clear picture of your cash flow with intuitive income/expense graphs. Analyze your expenses, compare trends, and uncover your most profitable areas of activity.
• 3) Stay on top of your spending with customized restrictions on categories, tags, and accounts. Set up automatic repetition for regular expenses, whether it's weekly or monthly.
• 4) Plan ahead with budgets for all your events and expenses, from weddings and vacations to home repairs and beyond.
• 5) Dive deeper into your finances by detailing your income and expenses with categories, tags, comments, and accounts. Add notes for deposits and expenses to analyze your finances with precision.
• 6) CC supports multiple currencies, so you can record cash flow in any currency you like, and let CC handle the conversion.
• 7) Use filters to organize and evaluate your cash flow based on your own unique indicators and preferences.
• 8) Edit your transaction records easily and quickly, even for past records, to keep your financial records accurate and up to date.
• 9) Stay within your budget by setting your desired spending limit with ease.
• 10) Switch between gadgets seamlessly, knowing that CC will keep your data secure in the cloud.

Download our app now and experience the power of CoinCount!
